title: Restriction of an extended sign assignment
statement: Let $a\leq K$, let $x$ be a sign assignment on $r$ original coordinates, and let $y$ be a sign assignment on $K$ auxiliary coordinates. Restrict the extension of $x$ by $y$ to its first $r+a$ coordinates. This equals the extension of $x$ by the restriction of $y$ to its first $a$ coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: Natural numbers a and K with a ≤ K
A sign assignment on r original coordinates
A sign assignment on K auxiliary coordinates
